The locally stored working copy was deliberately renamed to drop the ' 2' suffix ('260617_004-LAGO-BRITINYA_ARCH-DRAWINGS_COMBINED.pdf') so it collides cleanly with the canonical combined archive naming. The renamed alias is a LOCAL working copy, NOT the verbatim canonical source name; the canonical/original name is recorded in original_source_filename. All crop/scale facts below are measured from the locally stored alias file.
source.pdf_provenance: local working copy stored at planreader_data/elevation_sources/; original issued filename recorded as original_source_filename. All crop/scale facts below are measured from THIS local file.

calibration.notes: Re-measured from the REAL graphic scale bar on page 86 (E1 East, CD3001). 11 drawn tick marks carry the labels 0..10 at 1 m intervals -> 10 divisions -> 10 m represented length. The 11 ticks span 283.46 pt, so scale_pt_per_m = 283.46 / 10 = 28.346 pt/m, consistent with the stated 1:100 A1 scale (1 m = 10 mm = 28.35 pt). 11 positions, 10 spacings, represented length 10 m.

render.notes: Rendered page 86 with fitz.Matrix(150/72, 150/72), alpha=False. derived_px_per_m = scale_pt_per_m x pdf_point_to_pixel_scale = 28.346 x 2.083333 = 59.055. No assumed 96-DPI is used.

positive_benchmark.role: AUTHORITATIVE POSITIVE real 'glazed opening detected' benchmark (clearly-visible opening group)

crop.provenance: Committed real render crop (grayscale PNG) of a CLEARLY-VISIBLE glazed window opening group on the left/centre facade of E1 East, page 86 / CD3001. 3 structural bays, 9 glazed window lights. Cropped directly from the 150-DPI render of the source PDF to source PDF-point bbox [1020,634,1412,729]. This is the authoritative POSITIVE real-opening benchmark, in contrast to the negative/ambiguous repeated-cell crop (benchmark.crop). Geometry below is an independent annotation measured from the SOURCE vector linework, NOT from the detector.

independent_annotation.notes: Opening head/sill and every glazed light are measured from the source PDF vector linework (structural mullions and head/sill frame members). True positives are the 9 glazed window lights. A known non-opening (the solid spandrel band below the glazing) is annotated separately.

non_opening_regions.role: known non-opening solid facade panel (no glazing/opening)
non_opening_regions.note: Solid spandrel band immediately below the glazing band; correctly must NOT be detected as an opening by a well-behaved detector.

independent_annotation.opening_type_note: The annotated true positives are glazed window lights (visibly glazed openings within the facade framing). No D/W door/window mark is required because the drawing does not clearly show one at this scale; the glazing itself is the visible opening evidence.

diagnostics.note: The following detector observations are DIAGNOSTICS / regression observations ONLY and are NOT treated as benchmark truth. Benchmark truth is the independent_annotation above (9 true-positive openings).
diagnostics.assessment: Phase 2A only requires the detector to demonstrate useful signal above background noise. On this real positive crop all 9 independently-annotated openings are recovered (100% recall). The modest precision (0.5625) reflects geometric over-segmentation fragments of the dense glazing bars and merged bay-frame boxes; no opening is fabricated elsewhere in the crop at opening scale. Precision/noise are computed from the independent annotation only, not from setting a threshold at the current output.

crop.provenance: Committed real render crop (grayscale PNG) taken directly from the page-86 (0-based 85) 150-DPI render of the source PDF, cropped to the source PDF-point bbox above (241 pt deep, 84.8 pt wide). This crop is a NEGATIVE / AMBIGUOUS repeated facade-cell benchmark: its commercial identity, opening count, and type are NOT asserted (see benchmark_regions). It is NOT the authoritative positive real-opening benchmark; that is positive_benchmark.crop.

independently_measured_cell.width_derivation: Full-width repeated cells measured on REAL render pixels (crop px x[1,177]): 5 clean single-cell candidates at w=2.963 m reproduce at the ~2.96 m pitch, and the structural rib column spans 84.8 pt (= 2.99 m). Recorded as an independently observed geometric fact, NOT as commercial truth.
independently_measured_cell.height_derivation: The ~1.57 m cell height is consistently reproduced on REAL render pixels across all 5 repeated cells (h = 1.575 m each). This is a measured observation of the drawing's repeated cell geometry, now independently recorded (previously flagged as unsupported).

expected_on_real_crop.notes: Honest real-pixel measurement on the NEGATIVE/ambiguous repeated-cell crop: the extractor returns ~46 total / ~30 opening-sized candidates, of which ~10 match the independently-measured 2.96 m repeated-cell width and 5 are clean single-cell boxes (2.96 x 1.57 m). The remaining opening-sized candidates are over-segmentation fragments of the dense mullion/sash linework (0.5-2.05 m wide). The opening-sized limit of 40 is a documented engagement/sanity cap: the crop is only ~241 pt deep and holds a handful of real facade cells, so sustained output above 40 opening-sized candidates would clearly indicate runaway over-segmentation. This cap is an independent engineering guard, not a value tuned to the current detector output. All candidates stay dimension_basis=unknown and review.
